To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SMC to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) to fill various direct recruitment cadre positions across multiple technical, medical, and administrative disciplines in Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 18 vacancies have been announced under this recruitment notification covering various posts such as Director, Radiologist, Pathologist, Legal Officer, Administrative Officer, and different engineering positions.

faq.question: Q3. What are the start and last dates to apply online?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications starting from 3 November 2025. The final date to submit the online application form on the official Surat Municipal Corporation website is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General and Reserved categories?
faq.answer: Unreserved or General category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-. Reserved categories including SC, ST, SEBC, EWS, Female, and PWD candidates need to pay an application fee of Rs. 400/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Director (I.T.)?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Director (I.T.) post must possess a Master's or Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering branch along with at least 9 years of professional working experience in the respective field.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is generally set up to 45 years for direct recruitment posts, while some positions require candidates to be up to 35 or 40 years old. Age relaxations apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SMC various posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises multiple stages including a Written Test, a Practical Test, and an Oral or Personal Interview conducted by the Surat Municipal Corporation for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates must apply online through the official website of Surat Municipal Corporation at suratmunicipal.gov.in by registering, filling out the application form, uploading documents, and paying the fee.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any offline mode available for submitting applications?
faq.answer: No, offline applications are not accepted. Candidates must submit their applications exclusively through the online application portal provided on the official website of the Surat Municipal Corporation before the deadline.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification PDF directly by clicking the link provided in the Important Links section of this article or by visiting the recruitment portal on the official Surat Municipal Corporation website.
